item.title: High school students explore artificial intelligence at Wright State summer camp
item.description:
# High school students explore artificial intelligence at Wright State summer camp Area high school students received a hands-on introduction to the future of technology during the AES AI Camp at [Wright State University’s Raj Soin College of Business](https://business.wright.edu/), where they explored how artificial intelligence is transforming industries and creating new career opportunities.
Sponsored by the AES Ohio Foundation, the one-day camp introduced students to the fundamentals of artificial intelligence, machine learning and data science through interactive workshops and collaborative challenges. Participants explored the concepts behind AI and neural networks while building their own AI models.
Throughout the day, students like Hannah Sisco, a sophomore at Fairborn High School, worked together to develop AI-driven solutions to solve real-world problems.
“I’ve learned how different AIs can be used in different applications such as in healthcare and agriculture and things like that,” said Sisco.

item.title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman claims AI singularity has arrived
item.description:
# OpenAI CEO Sam Altman claims AI singularity has arrived OpenAI CEO Sam Altman claims [artificial intelligence](https://abcnews.com/Technology/what-is-artificial-intelligence-ai/story?id=99919927) has reached a long-sought threshold in which the technology can improve itself, unleashing rapid progress that may prove difficult to fully control.
The milestone, known as the singularity, promises significant benefits for society, Altman said, appearing to rebuke concern among critics about the societal threat [posed](https://abcnews.com/Business/artificial-intelligence-eliminate-thousands-jobs-new-york-city/story?id=133181521) by wide adoption of AI.

item.title: Cornerstone Launches President's AI Advisory Board to Lead the Future of Christian Higher Education
item.description:
# Cornerstone University Launches President's Artificial Intelligence Advisory Board to Lead the Future of Christian Higher Education Cornerstone University announced in a [FOX News exclusive](https://www.foxnews.com/culture/christian-university-aims-produce-irreplaceable-graduates-ai-reshapes-higher-education) on Saturday the launch of its new [President’s Artificial Intelligence Advisory Board](https://www.cornerstone.edu/ai-advisory-board/) to ensure that Cornerstone leads — rather than follows — in the integration of artificial intelligence across all aspects of the student experience and university operations.
“Artificial intelligence is the most revolutionary technology in the history of humanity. “Cornerstone will lead in this artificial intelligence moment through providing a sophisticated and compelling Christian framework for the understanding and use of AI to prepare our students to harness AI for the flourishing of all.”
### Founding Members of the Cornerstone University AI Advisory Board To that end, Cornerstone’s recently introduced an [Applied Artificial Intelligence Certificate](https://www.cornerstone.edu/programs/applied-artificial-intelligence-ai-certificate/), a practical, hands-on program designed to help students develop AI fluency and workplace-ready skills.
